embedding.instruction:
Instruct: Encode the following agent experience as a reusable problem-solving memory for semantic retrieval and SID clustering. Focus on the problem type, reusable skill, preconditions, procedure, decision rules, verification checks, outcome, and failure recovery. Prefer semantic problem-solving patterns over dataset names, run ids, wording artifacts, or incidental entities unless they are essential to the skill.
Query:
embedding.pooling: last EOS if present, otherwise last token; one text per forward pass
embedding.dtype: float16 on CUDA; float32 on CPU
